claim: For deterministic noiseless serial sensor-controller-actuator codes with no controller or actuator side information, fixed authority, timing-compatible delivery, arbitrary registered component computation, and one shared nonnegative transcript-tree cost on both ports that is invariant under symbol relabeling and deterministic fixed-prefix insertion/deletion, the closed read/write safety-capacity region is a diagonal quadrant. This holds for whole-language cardinality growth, minimax worst-case binary prefix-code length, and history-dependent causal branching cost, although their scalar entropy values can differ.
